steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Heracles (Hercules in Roman) was the greatest Greek hero, son of Zeus and the mortal Alcmene | Key Fact: Hera hated Heracles because he was proof of Zeus's infidelity — she sent two snakes to kill him in his cradle | Key Fact: Heracles was driven mad by Hera and killed his wife Megara and their children | Key Fact: The Twelve Labours were his punishment and path to redemption, set by King Eurystheus of Tiryns
